items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction (they do not move); E places a bomb (decrements bomb HUD). Space and Q were both pressed in the torch room this run with NO visible effect, so the top-right HUD icons may be passive indicators — unconfirmed whether Space/Q ever act. Wall hints say ITEM=Space. Death: all heart outlines empty and player sprite absent (an earlier death showed a bloodied X-eyed body). Hazard contact can drain 2-3 hearts extremely fast.

ITEM 'TECH X' (observed): collected from the green/white pill floating above the central rock in the two-poop room (earlier also from a red treasure chest). Grants goggles; firing spawns a laser ring ahead in the fire direction that lingers, grinds overlapping targets, then fades. Ring offset is NOT fixed (~130-325px observed), so point-blank and distance-math aiming are unreliable; sustained fire ~1-1.5s needed. This run it destroyed both brown poop piles and breaks rocks. Laser had no effect on: the golden coin object, the golden wall fixture, the hopper's spiky shell (hopper burst out and cost a heart), and locked-looking chests.

COINS (corrected): the small golden '$'-faced round object that appears where the right poop pile was destroyed IS A COIN — collected by walking over it (coins went 00->01). It ignores laser contact. Earlier guess that it was inert was wrong; earlier failures were bad contact position.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by firing into them or by contact once enemies are dead; drops include a heart+bomb orb and a heart. A red heart at full hearts converted into +1 bomb. Torch room's central gray chest embedded in a rock ring did NOT open by contact (no enemies alive) nor by laser — likely key-locked; keys HUD has stayed 00 the whole game. Dark chest room: two corner red-lidded chests resisted many laser hits (key/mimic guess); central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed; a corner chest contact earlier cost several hearts at once (mimic/spike guess, unconfirmed).

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast damages the player — 0.5s retreat was not enough, retreat far. Bomb inside a rock pocket cleared rocks but cost a heart. Bombing the white spike ring removed no spikes. Bombing cracked/stained right-wall patterns did nothing (likely decorative).

HAZARDS (observed): black spiders in the dark chest room are melee chasers and lethal. White round-faced 'hoppers' in the rock-field room are extremely dangerous: they teleport/phases around the room, ring themselves with spiky gray rocks, and leave green splatter clouds with green blobs that damage on contact. The shell is not stable — a hopper being lasered burst out of its shell and cost a heart, then re-shelled later. A green cloud cost a heart earlier, and a contact chain drained all hearts to death. Corner torches damage on contact. Diagonal rock chains block both straight and diagonal movement; single-axis moves through gaps work much better; being wedged needs a pure single-axis escape move into open floor.

TRANSITIONS (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend when standing fully centered; top gold crown hatches warp from centered below with sustained W; dark trapezoid doorways are ordinary connections needing sustained walking and fairly precise centering. Confirmed this run: tutorial room's TOP trapezoid door -> rock-field room; torch room's TOP alcove -> back to the TUTORIAL room (a loop, not a new area — correction to earlier assumption). Previously confirmed: tutorial bottom trapezoid -> torch room; torch room bottom gold trapdoor -> two-poop room; two-poop room top crown hatch -> torch room; tutorial right-wall doorway -> dark chest room. Right-wall doorways need the correct vertical band; the torch room's right wall failed pushes at ~y275 and ~y405 and its wall scratch looks decorative. In the dark chest room, sustained left pushes beside its left-wall door marking failed.

MAP (observed): Tutorial room (wall hints MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM, top and bottom trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway). Bottom -> torch room (central gray chest in rock cluster, corner torches, brown poop, top alcove back to tutorial, bottom gold trapdoor). Bottom -> two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles, floating Tech X pill, top crown hatch to torch room). Tutorial top door -> rock-field room (many gray rocks, golden wall fixture ~x255,y370 on left wall, white hoppers, at least a bottom trapezoid door). Tutorial right doorway -> dark chest room (corner red chests, spike-ringed central chest, black spiders).

GOLDEN WALL FIXTURE (unresolved): in rock-field room; touching it does nothing; laser never landed squarely; may be key-locked door/container or decorative.

UNEXPLORED: rock-field room's bottom trapezoid door (attempted entry under attack, never confirmed reached); any top door in rock-field room; two-poop room's other exits.

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/laser-opening locked or mimic chests without keys; firing while too close (ring overshoots); bombing spike rings and decorative wall cracks; lingering near hoppers or green clouds at reduced health; lasering a shelled hopper expecting a kill; assuming an open-looking lane is clear; hugging corner torches; retrying Space/Q when inert; treating laser particles as key pickups.

OPEN QUESTIONS: do Space/Q do anything at all; what opens the torch-room central chest and the dark-room red chests; what the golden wall fixture is; what is behind the rock-field bottom door; whether keys exist anywhere (keys HUD always 00); where health pickups come from (cleared rooms rarely drop hearts).
